title: StudioDeurbel's Snowman
description: A mod that adds a snowman block, as well as a pebble, which is a throwable item.
body:
![Mod Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7c45f8b23220cc39f65b9be0e01e5534becd4ee.png)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The StudioDeurbel Snowman mod adds a wonderful little buddy, as well as a completely new ranged-item; The Pebble, which is a bit less damaging than arrows, but they have **a lot** more knockback, which is perfect for getting your enemies away.
